scripts.test:security: node --import tsx tests/security/tenant-isolation.test.ts && node --import tsx tests/security/cross-tenant.test.ts
scripts.test:integration: node --import tsx tests/integration/auth.test.ts && node --import tsx tests/integration/project.test.ts && node --import tsx tests/integration/job-concurrency.test.ts && node --import tsx tests/integration/credit-ledger.test.ts && node --import tsx tests/integration/ssrf-e2e.test.ts && node --import tsx tests/integration/crawl-safety.test.ts && node --import tsx tests/integration/seo-audit.test.ts && node --import tsx tests/integration/idempotency.test.ts && node --import tsx tests/integration/api-contract.test.ts && node --import tsx tests/integration/dataforseo-wiring.test.ts && node --import tsx tests/integration/worker-completion.test.ts && node --import tsx tests/integration/google-oauth.test.ts && node --import tsx tests/integration/stripe-billing.test.ts

scripts.docker:build: docker build -t rankforge-web . && docker build -t rankforge-api -f apps/api/Dockerfile .
